Installation checks

Based on your entries

Installed RAM is not the memory available to the game. iOS limits, signing entitlements, temperature, graphics settings, and the port version can affect results. This page does not measure FPS or certify compatibility.

Sources and assessment method

Chip details come from Apple. RAM uses hardware teardowns or original analysis of Apple’s Xcode files. Unknown values stay unverified. This checker uses a site-level planning profile of 6 GB RAM, iOS 16 or later, and approximately 30 GB free storage. These are not verified release minimums. Follow the current release notes in our Discord server.
